Native diagnostic plots for FPCA predictive CV and bootstrap sensitivity

etr_native_predictive_visual_audits.Rd

Four independent, read-only R-graphics adapters for published eyetrajectoriespy 1.2 numerical plot geometry: FPC count predictive cross-validation, nested outer-fold loss, full-refit versus fixed-covariance mixed-effects simultaneous band-width ratios, and target-specific FPCA wild-bootstrap truncation width or center.

Plotting parameters

result

Explicit native R record of already-computed fold losses, outer-fold losses, or FPCA wild-bootstrap scan/selection values.

comparison

Data frame of already-computed bootstrap sensitivity ratios.

coefficient

Nonempty name of the coefficient to visualize.

target

Native one-based target index or named source curve identifier.

metric

Truncation interval width or center.

Details

Published Python 1.2 source plotting.py, commit c1cd95ad718327550f7e55393ff38582872f7a94. Single-fold predictive CV uncertainty uses sd_loss = 0; other sample standard deviations use the n - 1 denominator, matching pandas. No cross-validation, bootstrap, selection or model fitting occurs in these graphics functions. Returned native R geometry is not a Matplotlib Axes object. Python numeric target indices are zero-based while native R indices are one-based. Complete input, output, and error-schema equivalence has not been certified.

Value

Each function draws to the active base R graphics device and invisibly returns an auditable list of source numerical plot coordinates and provenance.
